admission.justification: Sending setup and task creation to a server resolved to live roots would mutate the wrong repository; exact server-info admission rejects foreign roots, repositories and providers before the corpus calls.

applicability: Corpus setup and task-document calls after the selected build server initializes.
conditions: The selected sandbox command is running on Linux with readable process or source observations; otherwise its named refusal applies.
exclusions: Protocol initialization and the server_info read necessarily precede this admission.
No unit case or new composed execution of the helper was run here; this claim is source inspection with retained producer-run evidence.

evidence: worker evidence 02-build.txt (the build against the real tool server succeeded)

statement: The build's corpus step makes no call through a tool server that does not report exactly the sandbox's coordination root and Projects folder, exactly the one repository `sandbox-app`, and no provider.
